content: Designs simulated: 2 and 3. Design 2 achieved gain 599.7, PM 52.3 deg, SR 26.9 V/us, UGBW 33.2 MHz (reward -0.6058). Design 3 showed ln1=45nm collapses gain to 91.6 (needs ln1>=90nm for ro), while Cc=1.0pF and Rc=2k achieved PM 62.7 deg. Plan: keep ln1=90nm, increase gm1 via W and I_tail to raise UGBW without losing gain. Handing over to modeler for model v1.

Model v1 (checked on designs 2 and 3)

Equations:
1. Gain: A = A1 * A2 = [gm1/(gds1+gds2)] * [gm6/(gds6+gds7)].
   Status: trusted. Measured error: +1.3% (pred 607 vs meas 600 on d2). Holds when all devices in saturation and ln1, lp1, lp3, ln5 >= 90nm.
2. Balance condition: S_mp3/S_mp1 = 2 * S_mn5/S_mn4.
   Status: trusted. On d2 ratio=1.0, offset=0.002 mV. Keeps stage 1 out DC at 0.595V and mp3 in saturation.
3. 2nd pole: p2 = gm_mp3 / (2 pi CL).
   Status: trusted. On d2 p2 = 24.5 MHz with gm_mp3 = 1.54 mS, CL = 10 pF.
4. UGBW: UGBW ~ min(gm1/(2 pi Cc), f(p2, zero)).
   Status: approximate. On d2 gm1/(2 pi Cc) = 60.4 MHz, but measured UGBW is 33.2 MHz (-45% from gm1 limit) because p2=24.5 MHz causes early rolloff. Increasing gm_mp3 or gm1 is required.
5. Slew rate: SR ~ 0.5 * (I_tail/Cc + I_2/(Cc+CL)).
   Status: trusted. On d2 pred = 26.2 V/us, meas = 26.9 V/us (+2.7% error).
6. Rc zero: fz = 1 / [2 pi Cc (Rc - 1/gm6)].
   Status: trusted. On d2 1/gm6 = 650 ohm, Rc = 1500 ohm -> LHP zero at 124.9 MHz. Provides phase lead for PM.
7. Phase margin: PM determined by dominant pole, p2, and LHP zero.
   Status: approximate. On d2 PM = 52.3 deg. Reducing Cc or increasing Rc / gm_mp3 shifts PM.
8. Total current: I = 30uA + I_tail + I_2 = 30 + 55.8 + 175.3 = 261.1 uA.
   Status: trusted. Exact match.

Known failures:
- ln1=45nm (d3) collapsed gain from 600 to 91.6 (-85% drop) due to short-channel gds degradation. Validity rule: ln1 >= 90nm.

Levers:
- UGBW: wp3/mp3 & I_2 (raises gm6 and p2), then mn1/wn1 (raises gm1), then smaller Cc.
- Slew rate: smaller Cc, larger I_tail (mn4), larger I_2 (mn5).
- PM: Rc (moves zero closer to UGBW), wp3 (increases gm6 / moves p2 out).
- Gain: longer L (ln1, lp1, lp3, ln5).

changed: v1 initial model from textbook equations calibrated against designs 2 and 3.

Best id 2. Binding spec: ugbw (33.2 MHz, -0.501), followed by phm (52.3 deg, -0.069) and slewRate (26.9 V/us, -0.055). Operating-point data shows gm1/(2piCc) = 60.4 MHz and p2 = 24.5 MHz with gm_mp3 = 1.54 mS. Chosen lever: increase gm1 by doubling mn1 (8 -> 16) and reduce Cc (1.5pF -> 1.0pF). Expected trade-off: UGBW > 60 MHz and SR > 35 V/us; check PM impact with Rc=1800 ohm.

Sizer round successful: mn1=16, cap=1.0pF, wp1=2.0u, wp3=2.0u, and sweep on res (best id 10 at Rc=3500 ohm) improved reward to -0.2218. PM reached 72.0 deg, SR reached 37.6 V/us, gain 708 V/V. Only ugbw remains violated (61.2 MHz vs 100 MHz target). Handing back to diagnoser.

Best id 10. Only ugbw remains violated (61.2 MHz, -0.241). All other specs feasible with excess margin (PM=72.0 deg, gain=708, SR=37.6). OP shows gm1/(2piCc)=94.9 MHz, p2=33.6 MHz. Chosen lever: trade excess PM margin for UGBW by reducing Cc (1.0pF -> 0.7pF), boosting wn1 (2.0u -> 2.5u), with Rc=4500 ohm. Expected trade-off: UGBW > 90-100 MHz, PM ~60-65 deg, achieving feasibility.

Sizer round result: Candidate 13 reached UGBW 102.6 MHz (feasible!), gain 738.6 V/V, SR 56.3 V/us, noise 0.0147. Only phm is 2.28 deg short at 57.72 deg (reward -0.0016). Handing over to diagnoser to tune PM across the 60 deg line.

Best id 13. Sole violated spec: phm (57.72 deg vs 60.0 deg, -0.0194). All others met with margin (ugbw=102.6MHz, gain=739, SR=56.3). Chosen lever: sweep Rc from 6200 to 8200 ohm on base_id 13. Higher Rc pushes LHP zero to lower frequency, adding +3 to +6 deg of phase lead. Expected outcome: PM >= 60.0 deg, reaching full feasibility (FoM > 0.3).

FEASIBILITY ACHIEVED in Candidate 22: reward 0.5214, zero violations. Specs: gain 688 V/V, PM 63.43 deg, UGBW 132.3 MHz, SR 57.5 V/us, noise 0.0138 V RMS, current 382.6 uA, area 6.06e-10 m^2. Handing over to diagnoser for Phase 2 optimization.

Phase 2 Optimization. Candidate 22 is feasible (FoM = 0.5214). Constraint margins: SR +31.4% (57.5 V/us), UGBW +13.9% (132.3 MHz), gain +55.0% (688 V/V), noise -37.0% (0.0138). Current has normalized penalty +0.313 (382.6 uA). Chosen global lever: increase mn3 (2 -> 3) to reduce both I_tail (90->60uA) and I_2 (270->180uA) by 33%, preserving balance ratio=6.0. Expected trade-off: current drops to ~270 uA, FoM increases ~0.15 while UGBW stays >= 105 MHz.

Optimization round successful: Candidate 25 is the new best feasible design with reward = 0.6103 (improved from 0.5214). Current reduced to 314.1 uA (wn3=1.25u, mn1=24). All specs satisfied: UGBW 100.0 MHz, PM 63.70 deg, gain 707.4 V/V, SR 51.97 V/us. Handing over to diagnoser.

Candidate 25 is optimal hand design with FoM = 0.6103. Specs: UGBW 100.0 MHz (tightly binding, margin +0.02%), PM 63.7 deg, SR 52.0 V/us, gain 707 V/V, current 314.1 uA, area 6.11e-10 m^2. Since UGBW is exactly at threshold, hand levers have reached the boundary. Deciding handover to rl for Phase 3 local refinement.

RL Phase 3 complete. Simulations used: 370 (100 warmup, 270 train steps, 270 updates). Replay size: 400. Feasible designs: 15. Best id before/after: Candidate 25 (FoM = 0.6103, source llm). RL generated feasible designs including candidate 71 (FoM 0.5636, cap=8e-13, mp3=14) and candidate 136 (FoM 0.5350, current=259.5 uA). Stopping after 2 batches without improving on candidate 25. Handing over to Phase 4 Polish.

Phase 4 Polish on best candidate 25. FoM = 0.6103. UGBW=100.04 MHz, PM=63.7 deg. Preference for single sweep: sweep Rc from 3800 to 4800 ohm (6 grid values) to find the exact peak of phase margin and UGBW trade-off around the 4200 ohm nominal point. Expected: refine FoM and check sensitivity.

Phase 4 Polish complete: Rc sweep confirms Candidate 25 at Rc=4200 ohm is the exact peak of the feasible FoM curve (reward 0.6103). Rc<4200 drops UGBW below 100 MHz; Rc>4200 adds area overhead without necessary margin. Candidate 25 confirmed optimal.

Phase 4 Polish on RL best Candidate 401 (FoM = 0.6131). PM is 60.33 deg (margin +0.33 deg), UGBW is 106.4 MHz. Sweep Rc across [4000, 4200, 4400, 4600, 4800, 5000] ohm on base_id 401 to evaluate phase margin safety margin and resistor area trade-off.

Phase 4 Polish achieved new overall best in Candidate 622 (Rc=4200 ohm on base_id 401). FoM improved to 0.6217! Area reduced to 5.78e-10 m^2. All constraints met: PM=60.00 deg, UGBW=103.5 MHz, SR=56.07 V/us, current=319.5 uA. Handing over to orchestrator.

RL Phase 3 finalized at budget limit (900 simulator calls total). TD3 training achieved new overall best Candidate 777 with FoM = 0.6357 (source rl_train). Specs: current=263.0 uA, area=7.18e-10 m^2, gain=589.7 V/V, PM=65.96 deg, UGBW=101.3 MHz, SR=51.58 V/us. Replay buffer contains 65 feasible Pareto designs. Handing over to Reviewer.

Review complete. Final best design: Candidate 777 with FoM = 0.6357 (feasible, 0 violated constraints). Full explanation written to harness_runs/harness_20261106_185541/explanation.md.
